details.detail: Door-3 self-service bar (m05, m06, q11) against ANA's official bar-counter render (Sam Chui, Jul 2019 press kit). The layout matches: black blind panel, monitor, cubby, bottle shelf, glass fridge with oval latch, black counter, 7 ash lower doors with round pulls, dark canopy with 3 downlights. It now stands aft of the door-3 cross-aisle, facing forward, as on the official map. Three things are off. The lower-door posts render dark bronze #45372c; the render shows warm light grey-bronze #8e7f6d. The counter edge rail renders #656a64 and is thin; the render shows a bright steel rail, #c5c0b9, about 0.04 m. No in-service photo of the door-3 bar was found, so this is verified only against a render. Monument depth is short of the map (see issues).

Door-2 welcome galley (the monitor galley). The upper unit matches two in-service photos closely: electrical panel with red and amber lamps, two aluminium units, landscape monitor over the coffee-maker bay and open cubby, tall smoked-glass cabinet with a round latch, black gloss counter, ash lower doors. Its back, facing rows 5-6, is unfinished: raw black upper and ash lower with dark z-fight blotches (a01). The counter edge in the photos is a thick rounded satin-aluminium nosing about 0.05 m that wraps the ends; the model has a 0.03 m rail. The dark soffit over the cross-aisle is missing.

Door-2 aft monuments (m04, a04, m13). The navy end panels with portrait monitors match ANA's 'entrance area' render. The face across the cross-aisle from the monitor galley is modelled as a white standard galley with aluminium carts and copper latches. The in-service photo shows a flat ash wall: aluminium-framed stowage flaps with red latches and horizontal aluminium rails, and no carts. The model's ceiling here is white; in reality it is a dark soffit with downlights.

F cabin front wall, flight-deck door and door 1 (q01, m01, m02, a03). The ebony flight-deck door has a white frame and white bolt-plate frames (matches tpa_IMG_0260). The pale mottled washi front walls match (model #b2afac vs omaatF_2 #bbb7ad). Missing: the charcoal curtains in both F aisles at the front wall. They appear in the frugalflyer row-2 aisle photo and tpa_IMG_0220. Door-1 galley inserts (m01) are not verified by any photo.

Lavatory exteriors. The ash door colour is right (model #baac91; render #ab987a). The hardware follows the render and not the real door. The in-service J lav door (OMAAT) has a white vertical grab handle, a white lock indicator and a white or pale-aluminium bi-fold seam strip, with no bronze frame. The door-2 forward lavs open onto the cross-aisle. The TPG row-5 photos show their doors on the rows 5-6 side beside the aisle curtain, with a lav sign, black ashtray and black occupancy box. Economy and wheelchair lavs (m09, m11) are plausible; the y_47302 pockets are present.

F/J bulkhead (m07). The J face is cream with the seam at 1.45 m and blue placards; the F face is washi (tpg_147, omaatF_2). The curtains render almost black and cool (#25242d). Real curtains are warm charcoal-taupe: #56504b (omaatF_2) and #4a453a (tpg_147, where the ceiling white reads #dbd6b5).

J/PY bulkhead, PY face (m08, q13). Light-grey tilted housings: 2 per outboard panel and 4 in the centre, as on the map. Grey pocket column on the outboard panel (py_37303) and bassinet mounts. PY curtains match py_37302 (model #393f5a vs #404254). The TPG PY photo under warm light reads #574a43, so the true tone is a neutral dark grey. The model is acceptable.

Door-4 group (q13, m09, m10). Behind row 27 is a plain off-white wall (model #c4c6c6 vs photo #e0e3ea) with two grey boxes (model #a4aab2 vs #b0b6c0), and dark slate curtains in both aisles. There is a wheelchair lav with white framed pockets, a right-side galley, and row-30 and row-31 monitors. All of this agrees with the ANA map and py_37302 / y_47302.

Rear (door 5: m11, m12, q19). Two fore-aft galleys face a centre work aisle with a lav outboard of each; there is a centre closet plus a diaper lav behind row 42 and light-grey rear curtains (model #999a9a vs y_47300 #888786). This matches the official map. No in-service photo of the new-config rear galley was found, so the finishes are unverified.

Standard galley inserts (door 1, door 4 and door 5). Aluminium trolleys, ovens, black beverage makers, copper latches, black deck. Plausible against the background of the OMAAT galley photo. The door-2 aft face wrongly uses them (see the door-2 aft detail).

Curtains overall. PY, PY aft-end and rear-economy curtains are correct in colour and place. The F/J and J-cabin curtains are too dark and too blue. Curtains are missing at the F front aisles and on the aisle openings of the door-2 forward monuments, which the TPG row-5 photos show tied back.

Jump seats. They no longer cut counters. They are near-black #3a4049 where the in-service seat is mid-grey on a grey pedestal. None are fitted at the door-2 forward outboard monuments, where lalf_133 shows one beside the door.

issues.detail: The back of the door-2 forward monuments, facing rows 5-6, is unfinished.
issues.problem: From row 5 looking aft (a01), the welcome galley's rear is raw black (#0d0d0f) above and ash below, with dark z-fight blotches on the ash. The left lav back is bare ash. The real wall (TPG row-5 photos) is warm cream laminate like the other J faces, with light-grey open-top wall boxes about 0.45 x 0.20 m at about 1.5 m, directly under the bins. It carries lit lav and no-smoking placards, and aisle curtains tied back beside it.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/tpg_The-Room-small-cabin-front_71.jpg: wall #a09489 in shade, boxes #b2b2a7 at x≈700/1600 and x≈320/1600 on the centre face. tpg_The-Room-small-cabin-back_70.jpg: wall #9e9187, box #aca79b. Model: scratchpad/a/a01_row5aft.png, upper #0d0d0f, lav back #928875.
issues.fix: In monoLayoutQA: `for (const m of mon) if (near(m.z0, 14.86) && near(m.z1, dz[1][0])) m.back = 'J';`. In monoBack: for 'J' centre monuments (|cx| < 1.3), add two wall boxes: `litPocket(B, X(cx + u, 1.50), MONMAT.wallBox, 0.20, 0.42)` for u = ±0.62. Fix the z-fight: offset the monoBack skin by 0.004 instead of 0.002, and skip monoStepBody's upper-body face at z0 when m.back is set.

issues.detail: Door-2 aft centre monument: wrong finish.
issues.problem: The monument facing the monitor galley across the door-2 cross-aisle is a white standard galley (buildGalley, galleyWhite #d6d3cc, aluminium carts, copper latches); the model renders its lower part #5f646c. In service it is a flat full-height ash wall: aluminium-framed stowage flaps about 0.55 x 0.85 m at 0.85-1.70 m with a small red latch at the top centre, two horizontal aluminium rails low on the wall, no carts and no work deck.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/lalf_133.jpg: left wall ash #c39579 in warm light, where the white door lining reads #a28c79, so the wall is about 0.9x the lining's luminance, like the lav ash #ccb489. Aluminium flap frames 0.03 m, red latches, rails. The ANA entrance render ref/web/monuments/samchui_10.jpg shows the same ash walls with horizontal aluminium rails at about 0.45 and 0.85 m. Model: scratchpad/r0/m04_d2aft.png, scratchpad/a/a04_d2bar.png.
issues.fix: In monoLayoutQA, give the door-2 aft centre galley `ashWall: true`. In buildMon's galley branch, for m.ashWall call a new ashWall(B, m) instead of buildGalley. ashWall does: monoBody with MONMAT.barAsh. Add k = 0..n-1 flaps, n = round(w / 0.62): each is gRBox(0.55, 0.85, 0.012) barAsh at y 1.28, framed by four gBox 0.03 strips in MONMAT.alu, with a MONMAT.red gRBox(0.04, 0.025, 0.02) latch at y 1.69. Add two rails gBox(w - 0.12, 0.022, 0.03) in MONMAT.alu at y 0.35 and 0.80, out 0.03. Keep welcomeEnds (navy portal panels) as they are.

issues.detail: The dark soffit over the door-2 cross-aisle is missing.
issues.problem: In both in-service photos, the ceiling over the galley cross-aisle is a dark warm-grey or bronze panel running from the aisle to the door, with 6-7 round downlights and a vent grille. The model has the white cabin ceiling (#c6c6c5) and a white light slab.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/lalf_133.jpg soffit #655b54, lalf_134.jpg #696567, both under warm light where white reads #a28c79, so the panel is about 0.6 of white luminance and neutral-dark. Downlights at about 0.4 m spacing in 2 rows. Model: scratchpad/r0/m03_d2fwd.png, scratchpad/a/a02_d3xaisle.png.
issues.fix: In buildMonuments after the monuments loop, for door 2 only (dz[1]): `B.add(gBox(4.6, 0.02, dz[1][1] - dz[1][0]), M4.trs(0, 2.14, (dz[1][0] + dz[1][1]) / 2), MONMAT.soffit)` with MONMAT.soffit = {c:'#4a423d', r:0.35, l:LAYER.wood}. Clip x to ±(wallAt(2.14)[0] - 0.05). Downlights: gCyl(0.035, 0.035, 0.006) MONMAT.downlight at x = ±0.45, ±1.2, ±1.95 and z = zc ± 0.22, y 2.128. Add one MAT.grille quad 0.3 x 0.12 at x 0.9.

issues.detail: The door-2 forward lavs open onto the cross-aisle, and no jump seats are fitted there.
issues.problem: The model's forward lavs at door 2 (x ±1.62..±2.70, z 14.86..dz[1][0]) have face 1, so their doors face the door-2 cross-aisle. In the TPG row-5 photos, the left lav's ash door (lav pictogram, no-smoking sign, black ashtray, black lit occupancy box, vertical handle) is on the rows 5-6 side next to the aisle curtain, facing the aisle obliquely. lalf_133 shows a grey jump seat on the outboard monument face beside the door, where the model puts the lav door.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/tpg_The-Room-small-cabin-front_71.jpg: crop x0-450, y250-520 at scratchpad/c_71L.png. ref/web/monuments/lalf_133.jpg: jump seat at px 530-600 x 560-900, left of the door. Model: scratchpad/a/a01_row5aft.png (plain ash lav back) and scratchpad/r0/m03_d2fwd.png (lav door on the cross-aisle).
issues.fix: In monoLayoutQA, set `doorSide: 'in'` on both lavs with near(m.z0, 14.86) && near(m.z1, dz[1][0]). In buildMon's lav branch, when m.doorSide === 'in', build the door, pull, occupancy box and sign on the inboard x-face instead of faceXF. Use `xf = M4.trs(inner + Math.sign(-cx) * 0.001, y, (m.z0 + m.z1) / 2 - 0.1, Math.sign(-cx) * Math.PI / 2)` and dw = min(0.62, z1 - z0 - 0.2). Then add jump seats [-2.25, dz[1][0], 1] and [2.25, dz[1][0], 1] to L.jumps. The orientation is [A] until confirmed (see questions).

issues.detail: Door-3 bar: trim colours differ from ANA's render.
issues.problem: The vertical posts between the ash lower doors and the outer frame render dark bronze #45372c; the render shows warm light grey-bronze #8e7f6d with a dark outer frame #342e2d. The counter nosing is a bright brushed-steel rail about 0.04 m tall (#c5c0b9); the model's rail is 0.022 m and renders #656a64.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/samchui_11.jpg: posts px 436-452 x 400-540 #8e7f6d; rail y 378-390 #c5c0b9; ash doors #ab9a81 (model #b3a588, fine). Model: scratchpad/r0/m05_bar.png, posts #45372c, rail #656a64.
issues.fix: Add MONMAT.barPost {c:'#9d8f7c', r:0.35, m:0.55, l:LAYER.brushed}. Use it in buildBar for the inter-door posts (the gRBox(cw, BAR.deck - 0.02, 0.02) backing and the dividers), and keep MONMAT.bronze only on the two outer frame edges. Change the counter rail to `gRBox(w - 0.03, 0.04, 0.035, 0.012, 1)` at y BAR.deck - 0.02 with a new MONMAT.steelBright {c:'#d4d6d8', r:0.25, m:0.9, l:LAYER.brushed}. Apply the same nosing, 0.05 tall and wrapping both ends with gRBox(0.035, 0.05, set + 0.05) at x = ±w/2, to buildWelcomeGalley in place of its 0.03 alu rail (lalf_134).

issues.detail: Lav door hardware follows the render, not the real door.
issues.problem: The J lav in the model has bronze side and top frames, a square recessed pull and a bronze VACANT plate. The in-service THE Room lav door (OMAAT) is plain ash with a white vertical grab handle about 0.04 x 0.25 m at 1.0-1.25 m, a small white lock or occupancy slot at about 0.88 m, and a white or pale-aluminium bi-fold seam strip about 0.04 m wide. It has no bronze.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/omaat_ANA-Business-Class-The-Room-32.jpg, crop x0-200, y150-600 (scratchpad/c_lav.png): door ash #ccb489, handle and seam white. Model: scratchpad/r0/m05_bar.png, m03_d2fwd.png.
issues.fix: In buildMon's lav branch, when J: drop the two bronze side frames and the top frame. Make the seam `gBox(0.04, 1.8, 0.024)` with {c:'#e6e4de', r:0.4}. Replace the recessed pull with `gRBox(0.04, 0.25, 0.03, 0.015, 1)` in MONMAT.plateWhite at at(so * dw * 0.38, 1.12, 0.03). Replace the occupancy plate with `gRBox(0.03, 0.05, 0.012, 0.01, 1)` plateWhite at y 0.88, with the green or red LED quad inside it. Keep the lit sign. The ashtray becomes MONMAT.bevBlack (black, per tpg_71).

issues.detail: F front aisle curtains and door-2 forward aisle curtains are missing.
issues.problem: Photos from row 2 looking forward show charcoal curtains at the front wall in both F aisles, open and gathered at both sides. The TPG row-5 photos show grey curtains tied back at both aisle openings of the door-2 forward monuments. The model has neither, so from F you look straight at the door-1 galley inserts (a03) and the flight-deck door (m02).
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/ffF_cabin-overview-from-aisle.jpg (curtains px 640-790 and 1020-1100, y 90-300). ref/web/monuments/tpa_IMG_0220.jpg (left aisle curtains). tpg_The-Room-small-cabin-back_70.jpg curtain #524a49, front_71 #625b5a.
issues.fix: In monoLayoutQA add `M('curtain', -1.62, -1.12, 7.50, 7.50, {xg: -1.21, tone: 'F', h: 0})` and `M('curtain', 1.12, 1.62, 7.50, 7.50, {xg: 1.53, tone: 'F', h: 0})`. Add `M('curtain', -1.62, -1.10, 14.84, 14.84, {xg: -1.53, tone: 'C', h: 0})` and `M('curtain', 1.10, 1.62, 14.84, 14.84, {xg: 1.53, tone: 'C', h: 0})`. For the tied-back look, scale the curtain bundle x by 0.6 and add a 0.03 m tieback band at y 1.05.

issues.detail: F/J and J-cabin curtains are too dark and too cool.
issues.problem: curtainF '#38373e' and curtainC '#36363c' render #25242d, near-black with a blue cast. Real F/J and J curtains are warm charcoal-taupe.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/omaatF_2.jpg #56504b. tpg_The-Suite-cabin_147.jpg #4a453a (ceiling white #dbd6b5 in the same frame, so the curtain is about 0.34 of white, warm). tpg_70 #524a49, tpg_71 #62574b. Model: scratchpad/r0/m07_FJ.png #25242d.
issues.fix: In MONMAT, set curtainF c to '#5c554f' and curtainC c to '#5a524d', both with r 0.9 and LAYER.fabric. Keep curtainY '#474b5e' (matches py_37302 #404254) and curtainRear '#8e8d8a'.

issues.problem: MONMAT.jump '#3a4049' renders near-black. The in-service seat at door 2 is mid-grey, about 0.55 of the white door lining's luminance, and stands over a tall grey stowage pedestal.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/lalf_133.jpg: jump seat #594c4c and pedestal #736c65, against the door lining #a28c79 in the same frame. lalf_134.jpg: #6e6e72.
issues.fix: Set MONMAT.jump to {c:'#8a8987', r:0.6, l:LAYER.fabric} and harness c to '#5c5f66'. For each jump seat, add a pedestal `gRBox(0.40, 0.46, 0.14, 0.02, 1)` at local (0, 0.25, 0.02) in {c:'#a3a19d', r:0.5, l:LAYER.plastic}.

issues.detail: Door-3 monuments are shallower than the map shows.
issues.problem: At the map's scale (rows 7-16 are 616 px for 9 rows at 1.36 m, so 50 px/m), the door-3 lavs measure about 93 x 66 px, roughly 1.85 m deep and 1.3 m wide. The bar is about 45 px (0.9 m) deep, with an angled alcove about 1.0 m deep behind it before row 17. The model uses MONO_LAYOUT.d3 = 1.05 m for all three. The map is schematic (the door opening reads only 0.8 m), so the error is about ±25%, but the lavs are still at least 1.4 m deep.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/ana_seatmap_73E.png, crop scratchpad/map73E_1.png: lav box y745-838, x186-252; B/G box y760-805; angled lines to y858.
issues.fix: Set MONO_LAYOUT.d3 to 1.5 for the lavs. Keep the bar at z1 = z0 + 0.9 and add two angled ash panels behind it: gBox(0.02, 2.0, 0.75) in MONMAT.barAsh rotated ±0.5 rad about y, running from (±1.1, z0 + 0.9) toward (±0.6, z0 + 1.5), as on the map. First check that rows 17-20 plus the J/PY bulkhead and PY rows 25-27 still clear the door-4 forward galley (pz27 + pyRecline < dz[3][0] - 0.6); if they do not, use 1.3.

issues.detail: The welcome-galley counter nosing and end frames are too thin.
issues.problem: In lalf_134 the black counter is edged by a thick rounded satin-aluminium nosing that wraps round the aisle end, and the ash end panel has a rounded aluminium 'picture frame' edge about 0.05 m around the galley opening. The model has a thin 0.03 m alu rail and square ends.
issues.evidence: ref/web/monuments/lalf_134.jpg (right end, px 1330-1420 x 150-900). Model: scratchpad/r0/m03_d2fwd.png.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley, add gRBox(0.05, 2.0 - dk, 0.05, 0.02, 2) in MONMAT.alu at both end edges of the set-back opening (x = m.x0 + 0.025 and m.x1 - 0.025, from y dk up to 2.0, z at the face), plus a top lintel gRBox(w, 0.05, 0.05).

issues.detail: Door-1 galley inserts seen from F.
issues.problem: With no front curtains, the white and aluminium door-1 galley (m01, a03) is visible from the F aisles. No photo verifies its finish. tpa_IMG_0260 shows only the ebony corridor.
issues.evidence: scratchpad/a/a03_Ffwd.png; ref/web/monuments/ffF_cabin-overview-from-aisle.jpg (the galley is hidden behind the curtains).
issues.fix: Covered by the front-curtain fix. Optionally, give the door-1 galleys facing the F aisles `back: 'F'` on their aisle-end panels, using washi via monoBack's F path.

questionsForUser: Door 2: the in-service photos (lalf_133/134) show the monitor galley across the cross-aisle from an ash wall. I can't tell whether that door is L2 or R2. If it is R2, the monitor galley is aft of the cross-aisle, facing forward, and the ash wall is the forward monument, which is the reverse of the model. Do you have a photo that shows which side of the door-2 cross-aisle has the monitor galley?
Do the door-2 forward lav doors face the rows 5-6 aisle (sideways, inboard) or the door-2 cross-aisle? The TPG row-5 photo suggests the aisle side.
No in-service photo of the door-3 bar in its ANA render form (blind, bottle shelf, blue fridge) was found. OMAAT calls it a 'small snack bar'. Is a real photo available, or should the render stand?
No photo of the new-config door-5 rear galley or rear lavs was found. Can you supply one?
Should the door-3 lavs be made deeper to match the map (about 1.5-1.85 m), even though that moves rows 17-27 about 0.5 m aft?
